documents.title: 39TH ANNUAL GENERAL MEETING OF TINNA RUBBER

analysis.summary: Tinna Rubber and Infrastructure Limited reported a strong start to FY27, delivering record quarterly profitability with EBITDA exceeding INR30 crores and PAT surpassing INR20 crores. Management highlighted strategic expansions, including increasing tire crushing capacity, scaling the PCMB and construction chemicals businesses, and advancing international projects in Oman, South Africa, Saudi Arabia, and Chile. The company reiterated its Vision 2029 target of reaching INR1,000 crores in revenue while aiming for sustainable EBITDA margins between 18% and 20% for the current fiscal year. Additionally, the company is progressing on renewable energy adoption and R&D investments to drive value-added product growth. Tinna Rubber and Infrastructure Limited reported its financial and operational performance for the first quarter ended June 30, 2026 (Q1-FY27), achieving record quarterly profitability with standalone and consolidated EBITDA exceeding Rs.

guidance.claim: The PCMB division is expected to contribute 10% of FY27 revenue.
guidance.quote: With enhanced manufacturing capabilities and strong business momentum, this division is expected to contribute 10% of FY '27 revenue.

guidance.claim: Management targets growth of over 30% in the PP Build Tech business and crossing INR100 crores in revenue in FY27.
guidance.quote: We are targeting growth of over 30% in this business and cross the milestone of INR100 crores in revenue in FY '27.

guidance.claim: The company aims to reach INR1,000 crores in revenue by FY29 while maintaining specific CAGR and ROCE targets.
guidance.quote: we are targeting presence across 10 locations and revenue of INR1,000 crores by FY29, while maintaining 25% plus revenue CAGR, 33% plus profitability CAGR and EBITDA margins over 18% and ROCE exceeding 30%.

guidance.claim: The steel abrasives business is expected to achieve approximately 30% volume growth in FY27.
guidance.quote: The steel abrasives business is expected to achieve ~30% volume growth in FY27.

guidance.claim: The Polymer Composite & Masterbatch business vertical is expected to contribute around 10% to FY27 revenue.
guidance.quote: This business vertical is expected to contribute around 10% to FY27 revenue.

guidance.claim: Management expects the contribution from the PCMB business to increase to 8% to 10% in FY27.
guidance.quote: We expect the contribution from the PCMB business to increase to 8% to 10% in FY27, supported by strong business momentum.

guidance.claim: The company expects about 20% to 25% growth in revenue in FY27 from the previous year.
guidance.quote: What I can tell you on overall revenue is we are expecting about 20% to 25% growth in revenue in FY27 from the previous year.

guidance.claim: Management aims to achieve revenue of INR1,000 crores while maintaining EBITDA margins of over 18% under Vision '29.
guidance.quote: We aim to achieve revenue of INR1,000 crores while maintaining EBITDA margins of over 18%.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand in the industrial segment is driven by rising raw material costs and ESG goals within tire manufacturing.
demand_outlook.quote: Rising raw material costs and increasing focus on ESG goals within the tire manufacturing industry continued to drive demand in the industrial segment.

demand_outlook.claim: The West Asia conflict caused bitumen supply shortages, increasing demand for rubberized bitumen as a cost-effective alternative.
demand_outlook.quote: The West Asia conflict led to temporary bitumen supply shortages and elevated prices, creating a stronger demand for our bitumen as a cost-effective alternative for road infrastructure projects.

demand_outlook.claim: The consumer segment was impacted by sharp raw material price increases and import/export disruptions affecting turfing project execution.
demand_outlook.quote: The Consumer segment was impacted in quarter 1 due to a sharp increase in raw material prices following the West Asia conflict, along with import/export disruption affecting the availability of key imported raw material to the turfing industry.

demand_outlook.claim: The industrial sector is experiencing robust growth driven by high prices of virgin polymers.
demand_outlook.quote: However, we are seeing very robust growth in our industrial sector. That is driven by, due to these crisis, the benefit that we have seen is there is higher motivation for blending of rubber in bitumen as well as for use of recycled rubber materials in new products. It is driven by high prices of the virgin polymers.

demand_outlook.claim: Consumer segment revenue grew by 23% despite a marginal decline in volumes.
demand_outlook.quote: Consumer segment revenue grew by 23% despite a marginal decline in volumes, reflecting the impact of price correction.

demand_outlook.claim: Steel segment volumes increased by 8% on a year-on-year basis.
demand_outlook.quote: Steel segment remained stable on Y-o-Y basis, while volumes increased by 8%, the company also appointed as an exclusive authorized distributor for Zibo TAA Metal Technology Company Limited of China for steel abrasive distribution across India, with the steel abrasive business expected to deliver 30% volume growth in the FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: During Q1 FY27, the company executed INR27 crores of capex as part of a broader INR100 crores plan across FY27 and FY28.
capex_expansion.quote: During Q1 of FY27, we have executed INR27 crores of capex as part of our broader investment plan of around INR100 crores across FY27 and '28, strengthening our growth and operational capabilities.

capex_expansion.claim: The tyre pyrolysis oil facility at Varle commenced trial in Q1 FY27 and expects commercial sales in Q2 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: The tyre pyrolysis oil facility at Varle commenced trial in Q1 of FY '27, and it is expected to commence commercial sales in Q2 of FY '27 with operations stabilizing by Q3 of FY '27.

capex_expansion.claim: The rCB production is scheduled to commence in Q3 FY27, followed by stabilization and commercial sales in Q4 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: The rCB production is scheduled to commence in Q3 of FY '27, followed by operational stabilization and commercial sales by Q4 of FY '27.

capex_expansion.claim: The company established Tinna Rubber Chile SPA to enhance global ELP sourcing and expand its international recycling footprint.
capex_expansion.quote: Tinna continues to strengthen its global presence with the establishment of its wholly owned subsidiary, Tinna Rubber Chile SPA in Santiago, Republic of Chile. The initiative is aimed at enhancing the company's global ELP sourcing network and expand its international recycling footprint.

capex_expansion.claim: The ongoing 3,500 MTPA MRP capacity expansion is progressing as planned and remains on track for commissioning by Q3 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: The ongoing 3,500 MTPA MRP capacity expansion is progressing as planned and remains on track for commissioning by Q3 FY27, increasing the Company's total MRP capacity to 20,000 MTPA.

capex_expansion.claim: The Company completed Rs. 27 Cr. of capex in Q1 FY27 against the planned approximately Rs. 100 Cr. investment over FY27-FY28.
capex_expansion.quote: Completed Rs. 27 Cr. of capex in Q1 FY27 against the planned ~Rs. 100 Cr. investment over FY27–FY28.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expanded its tire-crush capacity in India by 9% to 185,000 tons in FY26.
capex_expansion.quote: We continue to strengthen our processing capabilities during FY26 and expanded our tire-crush capacity in India by 9% to 185,000 tons.

capex_expansion.claim: Tinna Rubber incurred capital expenditure of over INR100 crores during FY26.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of our long-term growth strategy, we incurred capital expenditure of over INR100 crores during FY26.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has earmarked INR100 crores of capex over FY27 and FY28.
capex_expansion.quote: We remain committed to investing in the business and have earmarked a further INR100 crores of capex over FY27 and '28.

capex_expansion.claim: The Varale plant has reached a capacity utilization of 80%.
capex_expansion.quote: The Varale plant, the newest of our plants, has now reached capacity utilization of 80%.

capex_expansion.claim: The capacity of the polymer compounding facility in Haryana is expected to reach 18,000 tons per annum by the end of Q1 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: In line with our expansion strategy, we are enhancing the capacity of our polymer compounding facility in Haryana, which is expected to reach 18,000 tons per annum by the end of Q1 FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The company obtained land from the government of Saudi Arabia to set up a 24,000 tons per annum tire recycling facility.
capex_expansion.quote: In Saudi Arabia, we have already got the land from the government of Saudi Arabia to set up a 24,000 tons per annum tire recycling facility.

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved record quarterly profitability with EBITDA margins over 21% and PAT margins exceeding 13% on a standalone and consolidated basis.
margins_costs.quote: During the quarter, we achieved record financial performance with EBITDA exceeding INR30 crores, PAT surpassing INR20 crores, EBITDA margins of over 21% and PAT margins of more than 13% on both stand-alone and consolidated basis.

margins_costs.claim: Margin expansion resulted from operational efficiencies, cost discipline, and an increasing share of value-added products.
margins_costs.quote: This performance is the outcome of our sustained focus over the past few years on enhancing profitability through operational efficiencies, cost discipline and increasing share of value-added products.

margins_costs.claim: At the consolidated level, Q1FY27 revenues increased by 20%, and EBITDA & PAT margins improved significantly by approximately 575 bps and 416 bps on a YoY basis.
margins_costs.quote: At the consolidated level, Q1FY27 Revenues increased by 20%, and EBITDA & PAT margins improved significantly by ~575 bps and 416 bps on YoY basis.

margins_costs.claim: Renewable energy solar power contributed savings of INR 1.19 Cr for Q1FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Renewable energy (Solar Power) has contributed savings of INR 1.19 Cr for Q1FY27.

margins_costs.claim: Tinna Rubber delivered robust EBITDA margins of over 17% in FY26.
margins_costs.quote: FY26 was another year of strong execution for Tinna Rubber, despite geopolitical uncertainties and a dynamic operating environment, we achieved record tire processing volumes and delivered robust EBITDA margins of over 17%.

margins_costs.claim: Solar capacity was increased by more than 3x from 1.23 megawatt to 4.48 megawatt during FY26.
margins_costs.quote: During FY26, we significantly expanded our renewable energy footprint increasing solar capacity by more than 3x from 1.23 megawatt to 4.48 megawatt.

margins_costs.claim: Standalone EBITDA and PAT margins expanded by 286 bps and 161 bps respectively to 17.2% and 10%.
margins_costs.quote: On a standalone basis, revenue remained largely stable at INR533 crores, while EBITDA and PAT margin expanded by 286 bps and 161 bps, respectively to 17.2% and 10%, reflecting our strong operational performance and sustained efficiencies.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBITDA margin improved by 206 bps to 17.1%.
margins_costs.quote: On a console basis, EBITDA margin improved by 206 bps to 17.1%, while revenue and PAT grew marginally by 8% and 9%, respectively.

orders_capacity.claim: Tire crushing capacity currently stands at 185,000 tons per annum in India.
orders_capacity.quote: We currently have a tire crushing capacity of 185,000 tons per annum in India and continue to strengthen our processing capabilities.

orders_capacity.claim: Tire crushing operations in India operated at 88% capacity utilization, while Oman operated at 78%.
orders_capacity.quote: Tire fishing operations remained resilient in Q1 FY27 with capacity utilization at a healthy 88% in India and 78% in Oman.

orders_capacity.claim: The PCMB division's initial 6,000-ton capacity operates at 82% utilization, with expanded total capacity reaching 18,000 tons per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: The division's initial 6,000-ton-per-annum capacity operates -- is operating at 82% utilization, while the commissioning of the expanded facility in Haryana has increased our total capacity to 18,000 tons per annum.

orders_capacity.claim: The company secured a 15,000 tons rubberized bitumen processing order for execution in FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: The company also secured a 15,000 tons of rubberized bitumen processing order for execution in FY27.

orders_capacity.claim: Secured a 15,000 MT rubberized bitumen processing order, scheduled for execution during FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Secured a 15,000 MT rubberized bitumen processing order, scheduled for execution during FY27.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization remained strong at 90% for India operations and 85% for Oman in FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Tinna achieved all-time high tire processing volume in FY26 with capacity utilization remaining strong at 90% for India operation and 85% for Oman.

orders_capacity.claim: Tire crushing volumes increased by 13% in FY26 to 155,000 tons per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: Tire crushing volumes increased by 13% in FY26 to 155,000 tons per annum due to an increase in capacity and utilization.

capital_allocation.claim: The inventory of accrued EPR credits up to March 31, 2026, was fully monetized within Q1 FY27.
capital_allocation.quote: The inventory of accrued EPR credits up to 31st March 2026 was fully monetized within Q1 FY27.

capital_allocation.claim: The company allocates INR5 crores towards research and development in FY27.
capital_allocation.quote: We had mentioned in the past, and we are renewing our commitment to innovation by allocating INR5 crores towards research and development in FY '27.

capital_allocation.claim: Rs. 5 Cr. was allocated to R&D for FY27.
capital_allocation.quote: Rs. 5 Cr. was allocated to R&D for FY27.

capital_allocation.claim: Tinna dedicated INR 91 lakh in FY26 to CSR programs across sports, education, and healthcare sectors.
capital_allocation.quote: Tinna dedicated INR 91 lakh in FY26 to CSR programs - driving meaningful change across sports, education, and healthcare sectors.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a final dividend of INR3.25 per equity share for FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: In line with our commitment to delivering sustainable value to our shareholders, I am pleased to inform the Board has recommended a final dividend of INR3.25 per equity share for FY26.

capital_allocation.claim: The company raised approximately INR78 crores through a QIP in Q1 FY26, and the proceeds are now fully deployed.
capital_allocation.quote: During Q1 FY26, the company successfully raised approximately INR78 crores through a QIP, attracting participation from leading institutional investors like ICICI Prudential Mutual Fund, JM Financial Mutual Fund and Bank of India Mutual Fund. These proceeds are now fully deployed.

capital_allocation.claim: Total debt declined by 10% to INR121 crores in FY26 from INR134 crores in the previous financial year.
capital_allocation.quote: Balance sheet strength improved in FY26 with debt declining 10% to INR121 crores from INR134 crores in the previous financial year.

capital_allocation.claim: Cash flow from operating activities grew by 60% to INR57 crores during the year.
capital_allocation.quote: The company generated healthy cash flow from operating activities, which grew by 60% to INR57 crores during the year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Oman operations were temporarily impacted by the West Asia conflict, resulting in subdued volumes.
risks_headwinds.quote: India recorded a strong 35% Y-o-Y growth in tire fishing volumes, while operations in Oman were temporarily impacted by the West Asia conflict, resulting in relatively subdued volumes.

risks_headwinds.claim: Construction of the proposed Saudi Arabia facility is subject to the normalization of the geopolitical situation in the Middle East.
risks_headwinds.quote: Of course, this is subject to normalization of the geopolitical situation in the Middle East.

risks_headwinds.claim: Mbodla Investment Pty Ltd. in South Africa and Tinna Rubber Arabia Ltd. in Saudi Arabia reported a combined loss of Rs. 0.53 crore owing to initial start-up costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: Mbodla Investment Pty Ltd. (South Africa) and Tinna Rubber Arabia Ltd. (Saudi Arabia) reported a combined loss of Rs. 0.53 crore owing to initial start-up costs.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management has prudently revised the project implementation timeline in Saudi Arabia in light of evolving geopolitical uncertainties in West Asia and the GCC region.
risks_headwinds.quote: Management has prudently revised the project implementation timeline in light of evolving geopolitical uncertainties in West Asia and the GCC region, as ongoing supply chain and logistics disruptions continue to impact the broader industry.

risks_headwinds.claim: TP Buildtech's performance was impacted by currency fluctuation, crude oil volatility, and elevated polymer prices driven by the Middle East crisis.
risks_headwinds.quote: TP Buildtech's performance was impacted by currency fluctuation, crude oil volatility and elevated polymer prices driven by the Middle East crisis.

risks_headwinds.claim: Performance in Oman was impacted by higher raw material costs and export disruptions from geopolitical tensions in the Middle East during the last quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: Performance in Oman was impacted by higher raw material costs during the year and export disruptions arising from geopolitical tensions in Middle East during the last quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: Commencement of capital works for the Saudi Arabia plant was delayed due to Middle East tensions.
risks_headwinds.quote: However, due to the Middle East tensions, we thought it prudent to delay the commencement of the capital works and we are closely monitoring the situation.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to invest around INR100 crores in capex across FY27 and FY28.
management_commitments.quote: During Q1 of FY27, we have executed INR27 crores of capex as part of our broader investment plan of around INR100 crores across FY27 and '28, strengthening our growth and operational capabilities.

management_commitments.claim: The company is allocating INR5 crores towards research and development.
management_commitments.quote: We had mentioned in the past, and we are renewing our commitment to innovation by allocating INR5 crores towards research and development in FY '27.

management_commitments.claim: The tyre pyrolysis oil facility at Varle is expected to commence commercial sales in Q2 of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: The tyre pyrolysis oil facility at Varle commenced trial in Q1 of FY '27, and it is expected to commence commercial sales in Q2 of FY '27 with operations stabilizing by Q3 of FY '27.

management_commitments.claim: The company is targeting growth of over 30% in the PP Build Tech business and revenue crossing INR100 crores in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We are targeting growth of over 30% in this business and cross the milestone of INR100 crores in revenue in FY '27.

management_commitments.claim: The ongoing 3,500 MTPA MRP capacity expansion is progressing as planned and remains on track for commissioning by Q3 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: The ongoing 3,500 MTPA MRP capacity expansion is progressing as planned and remains on track for commissioning by Q3 FY27, increasing the Company's total MRP capacity to 20,000 MTPA.

management_commitments.claim: Recovered Carbon Black production is scheduled to commence in Q3 FY27, followed by commercial sales in Q4 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Recovered Carbon Black (rCB) production is scheduled to commence in Q3 FY27, followed by operational stabilization and commercial sales in Q4 FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Transition of customers for steel abrasives distribution via Zibo TAA Metal Technology Co., Ltd. will start from Q4FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Transition of customers will start from Q4FY27.

management_commitments.claim: The steel abrasives business is expected to achieve approximately 30% volume growth in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: The steel abrasives business is expected to achieve ~30% volume growth in FY27.

management_commitments.claim: The company earmarked INR100 crores of capex over FY27 and FY28.
management_commitments.quote: We remain committed to investing in the business and have earmarked a further INR100 crores of capex over FY27 and '28.

management_commitments.claim: Nearly 50% of power requirements are expected to be met through renewable sources from FY27 onwards.
management_commitments.quote: Nearly 50% of our power requirements are expected to be met through renewable sources from FY27 onwards, supporting both our ESG objectives and cost efficiency efforts.

management_commitments.claim: The contribution from the PCMB business is expected to increase to 8% to 10% in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We expect the contribution from the PCMB business to increase to 8% to 10% in FY27, supported by strong business momentum.

management_commitments.claim: Trial productions of the rCB plant are scheduled to begin in Q2 FY27, and both the pyrolysis and rCB plants are expected to be in full operation by Q3 of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: while trial productions of the rCB plant is scheduled to begin in Q2 FY27 and we expect both the plants to be in full operation by Q3 of FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to achieve revenue of INR1,000 crores while maintaining EBITDA margins of over 18% under Vision '29.
management_commitments.quote: We aim to achieve revenue of INR1,000 crores while maintaining EBITDA margins of over 18%.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
